finalText:
Build is clean now. Two bugs in the new bundler integration:

1. `src/core/options.js` was reading `options.retries` when the new bundler passes `options.retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`—added a check to treat that as `false` (the old default).

The 8 warnings are from deprecated APIs in old code (`Buffer()` constructor, `fs.exists`, etc.) and aren't real issues.
